name: Explainable
tagline: Voiced AI tutors for younger and older students that talk through problems conversationally.
problem: Two online tutors could not be everywhere their students needed them.
solution: Two assistants named after the university mascots tutor different age groups, streaming Gemini explanations with ElevenLabs voices.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask a question and hear the tutor explain.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Gemini API” among 112 submissions.
Separates tutors by age so tone fits the learner.

lessons: Fit the voice and tone to the learner's age.
